scope: Static probe and pinned dependency review plus Windows loopback TLS/QUIC tests only
findings: online() guarantees relay registration, not public UDP candidate readiness
Custom RelayUrl defaults QAD to UDP 7842 independently of HTTPS port
Minimal preset does not disable QUIC multipath or NAT candidate exchange
Application direct grace expiry preserves the connection and subsequent direct upgrade
WAN automatic-fallback probe closed roughly 4.6 seconds after handshake, without a sustained observation window
Two route snapshots, no tracing subscriber and discarded stderr cannot establish the WAN failure cause
The dependency's five-second retry scheduling is conditional, not an unconditional retry loop
remaining: Instrument QAD outcomes, candidate changes and connection/path timing in the isolated probe
Keep a single connection observable beyond its first transfer and record relay-to-direct transitions
Repeat a separately arranged cross-network test before attributing failure to NAT or UDP filtering
